subject: Discovery follow-up & next steps: narrow demo window and integration checklist

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@stellarnet.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up & next steps: narrow demo window and integration checklist

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a couple of tight asks so we can move to a focused technical deep dive:  

- Key priorities you mentioned: real-time inference for search ranking, S3-based private model artifacts, and audit logs for requests.
- Success criteria for beta: <=150ms tail latency at P95 for 10 req/s baseline; token-cost under $0.003/token after batching.
- Risk notes to investigate during deep-dive: existing auth flow (OAuth 2.0 / service account), expected max seq length, and whether you need on-prem connector for sensitive workloads.

Next steps (please confirm by replying-all):
1) Lock a 45-minute technical deep-dive with our SEs (we need an explicit yes/no so we hold one short slot). Two options: Wed Jun 2 10:00–10:45 PDT or Thu Jun 3 08:30–09:15 PDT. If neither works, propose one alternate within the next 3 business days.
2) Share any environment docs or IP allowlists before the call (I attached a short checklist).

Attachments: [attachment: MVP_integration_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

If you prefer I can loop procurement directly once timing is set. Want to avoid an open calendar hold — would rather lock one of the two slots and release the other.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Hi Karthik —

Sorry — I had to duck into a customer call and missed your note until now. Really appreciate the recap. Either of these slots could work but I need to confirm with Ops and procurement first. Can you hold both for a few hours while I check? If not, the best alternative for us would be Fri Jun 4 09:00–09:45 PDT or Mon Jun 7 11:00–11:45 PDT.

I'm copying procurement (procurement@stellarnet.io) so they can confirm the contract/terms folks who should be on the call. Also looping in our lead infra engineer, Priya Shah (priya.shah@stellarnet.io) — she'll likely want the deep-dive.

–Alex

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & next steps: narrow demo window and integration checklist

Thanks for the quick reply, Alex — no problem. We can't hold both slots all day; teams are tight this week. Two short options below — please reply-all with a simple "CONFIRM" on the exact slot you want us to lock. If we don't get a CONFIRM by 12:00 PDT tomorrow we'll release the earlier slot and offer a later window.

Option A: Fri Jun 4 09:00–09:45 PDT (45m) — we have Marissa (SE) and one of our runtime engineers
Option B: Mon Jun 7 11:00–11:45 PDT (45m) — full SE + product designer if you'd like a broader walkthrough

Prep for the deep-dive: if Priya can share the following ahead of time it would speed us up — VPC/network diagram, a sample request load, and any compliance constraints.

Attaching a draft SOW so procurement can preliminarily review scope (no signature needed yet).

Attachments: [attachment: SOW_draft_v1.docx (docx)]

Appreciate the quick confirm. If it's helpful I can send an official calendar invite + agenda after you CONFIRM.

Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Stellarnet Procurement <procurement@stellarnet.io>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & next steps: narrow demo window and integration checklist

Alex — quick note from the SE side: happy to focus the deep-dive on the three priority areas Karthik listed. For the runtime demo I'll bring:
- baseline perf numbers for 10/50/100 TPS with and without KV-caching
- a short demo of prefix caching and a recommended batching profile

If Priya can also share whether you'll be using prebuilt connectors or rolling a custom auth flow, that will determine how much of the session we spend on integration vs. performance tuning.

Also — if procurement will want a high-level cost estimate during the call we can bring a ballpark line-item slide, but we prefer that procurement get a copy of the draft SOW beforehand (attached by Karthik).

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
